content:
Hi all,

Just for your info, there's a recent Java4Shell (CVE-2026-114938) (https://www.aikido.dev/blog/java-17-rce-vulnerability-cve-2026-114938). and I suppose dataverse and solr are also effected.
could anybody please confirm ?

best regards,
Oussama

#infra-ops > Relevant Security Updates Tracker :wink:
TL;DR: Dataverse images updates landing very soon!
They have merged and released the new JRE images. Maintenance workflow kicked off, updated Dataverse images for 6.11, 6.12 and 6.12.1 should land soon!

Gnarf. They merged, but apparently, it will take even longer to build and ship all the updated images with 21.0.13.1 to Docker Hub! As soon as we see https://hub.docker.com/layers/library/eclipse-temurin/21-jre-noble/images/ carry an entry ENV JAVA_VERSION=jdk-21.0.13.1+2 we need to kick our maintenance run off again. :rolling_eyes:
Gotcha. Do you know of anything to track, like a running GitHub action or a pull request? Or should we just hit refresh now and then?

AFAIK their builds happen at Docker Hub, as they are a Docker Library project. And I don't believe there is anything we can track except for updates of the tag and the layer. I might be not correctly informed.
6 messages were moved here from #infra-ops > Relevant Security Updates Tracker by Oliver Bertuch.

I just found https://github.com/adoptium/temurin/issues/326 via https://adoptium.net/news/2026/11/temurin-november-2026-cspu-java4shell and it seems to show status. For jdk21 images it has a pause button icon (:pause:) that means "not started":

Courtesy by @Don Sizemore: try out if you're affected with this check command from RedHat:

grep '^flags[[:blank:]]' /proc/cpuinfo | awk -vRS='[[:space:]]+' -vORS=' ' '/^(avx512f|avx512bw|avx512vbmi|bmi2)$/ && !flags[$0]++; END{printf ": %s hardware!\n", length(flags)==4?"VULNERABLE":"Unaffected"}'
If images don't land today, I'm not gonna press the button tomorrow. Auto runs of maintenance will be run on Sunday anyway.

Oliver Bertuch said:

If images don't land today, I'm not gonna press the button tomorrow. Auto runs of maintenance will be run on Sunday anyway.

Good afternoon, were the dataverse images updated ? should I update as well ?
thank you and best regards :)
Ouss

The "dataverse" container looks good. It's running Java 21.0.13.1 now.

[rocky@ip-172-31-37-44 ~]$ head /opt/dataverse-demo/compose.yml
version: "2.4"

services:

  dataverse:
    container_name: "dataverse"
    hostname: dataverse
    image: gdcc/dataverse:6.12.1-noble
    restart: on-failure
    user: payara
[rocky@ip-172-31-37-44 ~]$ sudo docker exec -it dataverse java --version
openjdk 21.0.13.1 2026-11-17 LTS
OpenJDK Runtime Environment Temurin-21.0.13.1+2 (build 21.0.13.1+2-LTS)
OpenJDK 64-Bit Server VM Temurin-21.0.13.1+2 (build 21.0.13.1+2-LTS, mixed mode, sharing)
[rocky@ip-172-31-37-44 ~]$
We don't build or publish the Solr image. @Oussama Zoubia (UKK) have you been able to track down any details on what the Solr project is doing to address the vulnerability?

Hmm, I don't think Solr has built new images yet:

"* Patched images are not available yet. The Solr images are built on Eclipse Temurin, and a rebuilt Solr image can only be published once patched Temurin base images are released. That may take anywhere from hours to days."

From https://solr.apache.org/news.html#apache-solr-and-java4shell-cve-2026-114938

Hmm, according to https://solr.apache.org/downloads.html

<9.11 All older versions are End Of Life (EOL)

And this is the tag we use in Docker - solr:9.8.0.

@Oussama Zoubia (UKK) have you tried this? Do you know if it works?

"If you can't patch yet, start the JVM with -XX:-UseBASE64Intrinsics or -XX:UseAVX=2 (x86-64 only). Do not use -XX:DisableIntrinsic=_base64_decodeBlock alone - it can break JVM startup." -- https://solr.apache.org/news.html#apache-solr-and-java4shell-cve-2026-114938
You could also try the Solr 9.11 image. Maybe it "just works"?
